messages.content: Turn this session into something the README can hold.
Reading the session's beats. Measuring the pause after each reply.

The README can carry a session three ways.

- **One animated SVG** — it plays right in the page
- **A poster that links out** — a still that loads anywhere
- **Slides** — one page per beat, laid in a row

The first keeps the motion, and the camera work survives with it.
Write the script to {{@examples/readme-demo.json|@exa}}. I will tune the pacing in the studio.

Scripted — the studio retimes it, and `pnpm render` writes the SVG.

```json
{
  "title": "Readme demo",
  "surface": "app",
  "basis": "fictional",
  "camera": { "follow": true, "zoom": 1.6 },
  "messages": [
    { "role": "user", "content": "Open on the summary, please." },
    { "role": "assistant", "content": "Rolling. Camera is yours." }
  ]
}
```

Every exchange above is just a line in this shape — retype one and the render follows.
